Drink in the sunset behind the 100-mile, 180-degree Catskill Mountain and Hudson Valley view. Hidden from site up a long private road, this immaculate contemporary home begins with a two-story glass window framing the view with a soaring fieldstone fireplace warming the great room; private first floor master suite enjoys its own screened in porch with view of private pond, spacious updated kitchen and dining complete the first floor. Upstairs there is a second master suite, office/bedroom with fireplace, library and private balcony, plus an additional BR/bath and laundry room. Third floor loft space for media or office. 3-car garage with studio and bath. Masterfully-done stone walls around the ponds and throughout the walkways. Wooded trails lead to a giant glacial erratic - the Magic Boulder. Be sure to view 167 Madison Avenue Canaan NY 12029.
